goal: Independent 3D COMSOL reference, diagnose long-record phase error, then supervised corrective training without mixing reference and prediction.

reference_physics.geometry: 3D finite plate first; no equivalence claimed with prior 2D model
reference_physics.material: fixed aluminum full Murnaghan constants, unchanged by calibration
reference_physics.load: nominal whole-face traction in the reference configuration
reference_physics.boundary: xmax fixed, other faces natural and free

reference_admission.spatial_time_quadrature_checks: explicit independent refinement; completion or small energy drift alone is insufficient
reference_admission.fail_action: retain failed evidence and refine; never label unconverged reference as ground truth
reference_admission.signature_evidence_scope: Signed responses verified during collection; published archive retains verification attestation and artifact hashes, not raw signature headers

training.focus: learned spatial filters and dispersion; retain physical energy law and conservation constraints
training.admission: only verified COMSOL development labels; held-out target waveforms never enter optimization
training.split_note: This supports a fixed-material, bounded-geometry assessment. The previously inspected numerical baseline is retained; no claim that it was unseen during algorithm design.
training.promotion: only on predeclared independent validation metrics; otherwise preserve baseline and mark candidate unqualified

modal_development.purpose: Separate spatial phase error from transient time integration; actual COMSOL supervision plus nonlinear physical constraints
modal_development.trainable: Centroskew P4 filter perturbations preserving constant and affine derivatives; v1 also preserves quadratics
modal_development.input: signed 3D COMSOL eigenfrequencies and mode shapes with exact-order energy postprocessing
modal_development.reference_comparison: independent h refinement; paired modes by mass-weighted modal assurance

long_phase_reference_admission_separate.description: Research frequency admission alone cannot certify 5 ms waveform accuracy

experiments.description: Constrained derivative filter trained only on admitted development eigenmodes
Additional filter capacity; retain exact constant and affine derivatives, rigid motion, parity, mass and material energy; same reference admission gate

experiments.outcome: 5% physical checks passed, optimizer line search unsuccessful; not promoted

experiments.method: offline parameter backtracking using training constraints only

experiments.description: Project the parent P4 derivative onto exact constant/affine constraints before fitting; then verify 12 finite rigid states in both nonlinear controls

initial_filter_consistency_projection.scope: offline weight projection before training; no inference correction

transport.compression: explicit workai_gzip_csv_v1 CSV container when requested; decoded data SHA-256 and byte count are in the signed completion receipt

solver_development.bdf: 200 us engineering trial, not part of heldout 5 ms verification; retain its actual completion or failure
solver_development.dopri5: COMSOL native fifth-order Dormand-Prince 5 pilot using documented Time solver; must pass explicit step refinement before use

modal_postprocessing.forced_interval: scaled DOP853 relative tolerance 1e-11, verified at 1e-12
modal_postprocessing.unforced_interval: analytic modal oscillator evolution; no padding or repeating sampled data
modal_postprocessing.role: independent linear diagnostic for all four signals and cycle counts; cannot replace nonlinear 5 ms certification

nonlinear_physical_constraints.manufactured_fields: six longitudinal, transverse, torsion and mixed polynomial families; independent analytic stresses, chain-rule divergence, body forces and six-face tractions; displacement shape(X)*(1-cos(omega*t))
